answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric verification provides a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies. By binding an AI identity to a unique human biometric signature, the system forces attackers to acquire physical identities, which are costly to scale. An attacker attempting to simulate a violet swarm must pass a velvet security hurdle, akin to a falcon spotting prey, to gain network access. Each fake identity requires a legitimate biometric input, imposing prohibitive capital costs per node.
